document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your party exchanges salvos with the strange entities. It seems 
they must come quite close to use the full effect of their cold-
beam projectors.

Each of you with a rifle may fire 3 times at normal range before you 
become too numb from the indirect fire of the alien weapons. If you 
score 3 hits between the two of you, go to 381. If you do not, you are 
rendered unconscious; go to 417.
